result.title: Jet-QSparse: Accelerating Agentic LLM Inference with 4-Bit Sparse Attention
result.summary: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 Jet-QSparse，一种免训练的长上下文推理加速方法：用 NVFP4 压缩 KV 缓存（配合 key centering 与少量 BF16 页修正量化误差），并用 FP4 query-key 计算密集打分、按 128 token 块稀疏取块后用 FP16 聚合，在四个混合 LLM 上报告大预算下无明显精度损失并获得约 2 倍解码加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「分数全量扫描 + 块级稀疏聚合」与「低精度缓存仍保精度」两点，可供核查 LVR 中基于注意力分数的证据筛选预算、以及视觉细节在压缩内部状态中的保真度；但该文纯属效率工程，无多模态与 latent 推理设计，借用需较多核查。
